description: This file is a PHPUnit test class for the LeavePeriodDao component within the Leave plugin of the OrangeHRM system. It contains multiple test cases verifying the behavior of leave period history saving, retrieval, and entitlement adjustments when leave periods change.

classes.name: LeavePeriodDaoTest
classes.description: A PHPUnit test suite for testing LeavePeriodDao functionalities such as saving leave period history, retrieving current and past leave periods, and handling entitlement adjustments upon leave period changes.

methods.name: setUp
methods.description: Initializes the test environment, creating a new instance of LeavePeriodDao and populating test data from a YAML fixture.

methods.name: testSaveLeavePeriodHistoryFirstTime
methods.description: Tests saving a new leave period history when no existing period is recorded, ensuring proper creation and configuration.

methods.name: testSaveLeavePeriodHistory
methods.description: Tests updating leave period history when a current period exists, including manipulation of leave entitlement strategies.

methods.name: testSaveLeavePeriodHistoryWithTransactionException
methods.description: Verifies that a transaction exception is properly thrown and handled when an error occurs during leave period saving process.

methods.name: testGetCurrentLeavePeriodStartDateAndMonth
methods.description: Tests retrieval of the current leave period's start date and month, ensuring accuracy.

methods.name: testGetLeavePeriodHistoryList
methods.description: Verifies the retrieval of the full list of leave period histories, asserting their correctness.

methods.name: testEntitlementChangeWhenLeavePeriodChanged
methods.description: Checks adjustment of leave entitlements for employees when the leave period is changed, including verification of splited and updated entitlement periods.
